page.notes: Printed letters are copied as seen. Long s is written as s. Ligatures of "fp" and "ft" are read as "sp" and "st". The word "quædam" has a blot over it and is marked [?]. The page reference "p. 51" for "Terræ quid notent?" is copied as printed. The running head is set in spaced capitals. The entry "Mosis asserta" is partly obscured and read with [?] in the text on the word, not here. The reading "Timulachro" is doubtful. The first line "p. 333" is a page reference set above the first headword and is kept as printed.
